case_classification.short_description: Forecast for a SaaS company including industry specific metric - in three scenarios

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task requires building a highly detailed, 20-year monthly SaaS model (240 periods) across three distinct scenario sheets, plus answering 35 specific metric-based questions. The modeler must correctly implement annual inflation adjustments occurring every January relative to a 2025 baseline, handle specific timing rules for customer billing (excluding new and churned customers in the current month's revenue), and compute complex SaaS metrics like LTV, LTV/CAC, CAC Payback, and Cash Runway. Replicating the logic across three cases, ensuring formulas are robust, and precisely linking or looking up the 35 multi-scenario, multi-period questions will take an expert modeler about 85 minutes.
